Return the unfortunate news to Guardsman Pah.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Speak to [[Guardsman Pah]] about filling out the ministry's scrollwork.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* [[Imperial Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==

This quest is quite easy, all it requires is for you to retrace your path taken in the previous quest back to Guardsman Pah.

Alternatively, map travel to [[Nahpui Quarter (outpost)|Nahpui Quarter]] and return into Wajjun Bazaar to Guardsman Pah.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
'''Officer Chitaro'''
:''"'''Guardsman Pah''' has not completed the proper scrollwork at the Ministry of Flame. Please ask him to refrain from making requests of me without going through the proper channels."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I'll tell him.
|decline = I am not your messenger.
|ask = Please deliver my message to '''Guardsman Pah''' before he sends someone else to pester me. 
|indent = :: }}


===Reward dialogue===
'''Guardsman Pah'''
:''"I am very sorry to hear that. The ministry does not seem to understand that this situation allows us no time to wade through piles of scrollwork."''

[[Category:Rewards Imperial Commendation]]

==Notes==
* This quest appears to be mutually exclusive with the [[Imperial Assistance]] quest.
